en_title: GTA 6: How The Ultimate Edition Content Works
opus_summary: 《GTA6》游戏内商店透露，终极版奖励分布在Jason和Lucia故事的各个章节中，部分内容仅在特定时段可用，错过后将永久无法使用。多数奖励在游戏早期即可获得，并能在之后的冒险中持续使用。

paragraphs.en: Ever since pre-orders for GTA 6 went live and its $100 Ultimate Edition was revealed, one question has been asked more than any other: Is it worth it?
paragraphs.cn: 自《GTA6》开启预购、售价100美元的终极版公布以来，有一个问题被问得最多：它值得买吗？

paragraphs.en: Well, if our poll ran at the time is any indication, 70% of you certainly felt that way, with the majority opting for the full GTA 6 experience over the standard version.
paragraphs.cn: 如果我们当时进行的投票能说明什么的话，那么你们当中有70%的人确实认为值得，大多数人选择了完整的《GTA6》体验，而不是标准版。

paragraphs.en: We’ve long known what is included in the more expensive edition, from personalised vehicles and weapons to exclusive stores and missions. But what we didn’t know was how exactly we’d access this extra stuff or when we’d be able to use it. Well, now we do, thanks to the details listed in the in-game store, which states, “Ultimate Edition bonuses are threaded across all aspects of Jason and Lucia’s Story, with new items uncovered behind each chapter”.
paragraphs.cn: 我们早已知道价格更高的版本包含哪些内容，从个性化载具和武器到独占商店和任务都有。但我们此前并不知道究竟该如何获取这些额外内容，也不知道什么时候才能使用它们。现在，多亏了游戏内商店列出的详情，我们知道了。商店中写道：「终极版奖励贯穿Jason和Lucia故事的各个方面，每个章节之后都会发现新物品。」

paragraphs.en: It turns out that these extras will be sprinkled throughout the story, unlocking over the course of its chapters, with some only being available to use during certain timeframes, and even permanently removing your access to them once you pass points in Jason and Lucia’s tale.
paragraphs.cn: 原来，这些额外内容将分布在整个故事中，随着章节推进而解锁。其中有些只能在特定时段内使用，甚至在Jason和Lucia的故事推进到某些节点之后，你就会永久失去使用它们的权限。

paragraphs.en: Here’s the full list of the bonuses and when you’ll be able to get your hands on each:
paragraphs.cn: 以下是奖励的完整列表，以及你可以获得每项奖励的时间：

paragraphs.en: So, enjoy those early Jason vehicles while you can, as once they’re gone, they’re gone forever. Most of the bonuses are available from early on, though, and remain there for you to use throughout the whole of your adventure through Leonida. Just one word of advice: even though you can visit some places, such as Stock 305 clothing, you may not have the cash early on to actually afford anything there. It’s a pricey place.
paragraphs.cn: 所以，趁还能使用的时候好好享受Jason早期的那些载具吧，因为一旦失去，就再也拿不回来了。不过，大多数奖励从早期就可以获得，并且在你整个Leonida冒险旅程中都可以使用。只是有一个建议：尽管你可以前往Stock 305服装店等一些地方，但早期你可能没有足够的现金买下那里任何东西。那里的东西很贵。

paragraphs.en: Are you happy with how the exclusive Ultimate Edition content is spread throughout GTA 6? Let us know in the comments!
paragraphs.cn: 你对终极版独占内容在《GTA6》中的分布方式满意吗？请在评论中告诉我们！

paragraphs.en: We’ve got plenty more GTA 6 for you here at IGN. You can check out our review, or head over to our launch live blog , where I’ll be doing my best to answer as many of your spoiler-free questions as you may have about the game.
paragraphs.cn: IGN还为你准备了大量《GTA6》相关内容。你可以查看我们的评测，或前往我们的发售实时博客，我会在那里尽力回答你们关于这款游戏的无剧透问题，能回答多少就回答多少。
